title: Show AI your screen in one keystroke.
name: Screenshot tool
description: Two hotkeys that put a screenshot straight on your clipboard, ready to paste into any AI chat. Capture the whole display or drag a box around the part that matters.
benefit: Stop describing what's on your screen. Show it.
tryIt: Capture an error, paste it, and ask: "Explain this error and the next step I should try."
platform: macOS, with the free Hammerspoon app
needs: Five minutes to install. No account, no API key. Nothing leaves your Mac.

title: Ask for the shortcut. Keep your hands on the keys.
name: NextKey
description: Press a hotkey, say what you want to do, and NextKey tells you which keys to press. It looks at your screen, so the answer fits the app you're actually in.
benefit: Learn the shortcuts for your own tools, one real task at a time.
tryIt: Open Excel, press Option + Command + /, and ask: "How do I freeze the top row?"
needs: Xcode command line tools to build it, and your own OpenRouter API key. The tool is free; you pay OpenRouter for the AI usage. Each question sends a screenshot to the AI model you choose.

title: Turn a process into a walkthrough people can click through.
name: flow-stepper
description: A Claude skill that turns a description of how something works into an animated, step-through diagram: boxes, wires, numbered captions and Back/Next buttons, in one HTML file.
benefit: Explain a process once, in a form people can step through at their own pace.
tryIt: Ask Claude: "Use flow-stepper to build a walkthrough of how our deploy pipeline works."
platform: Claude Code or claude.ai with code execution
needs: Python 3. No packages, no account beyond Claude. The page it makes works offline.
